# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** file a public issue for security bugs. Instead, email
**security@careerpilot.example** (replace with your real address) and include:

- A short description of the bug
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept
- The impact you believe it has

We aim to acknowledge reports within 2 business days and provide a fix or
mitigation timeline within 7 business days.

## Supported versions

Only the latest minor release receives security patches. Older versions will
not be backported.

| Version | Supported          |
|---------|--------------------|
| latest  | ✅                 |
| < latest| ❌ (upgrade)       |
